A '''munitions factory''' was located in the [[Labor Valley]] district of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]], it was damaged by bombing, exposing the [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedos]] that were stored in the factory.
